subject: general
question: What is the theme of 11th International Day of Yoga IDY 2025?

options.text: Yoga for One Earth, One Health

solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Yoga for One Earth, One Health**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• 11th International Day of Yoga: June 21.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **11th International Day of Yoga (IDY)** observed on **June 21, 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
**Theme** for 2025: **“Yoga for One Earth, One Health”**.

 
 
• 
 
**Recognized by** the **United Nations General Assembly (UNGA)** via **Resolution 69/131** on **December 11, 2014**.

 
 
• 
 
**First celebrated globally** on **June 21, 2015**.

 
 
• 
 
**Organized by** the **Ministry of AYUSH**, with support from **state governments**, **embassies**, and **UN bodies**.

 
 
• 
 
Aims to **strengthen India’s cultural diplomacy** and promote **global wellness through yoga**.
